slideshow.emptyHint: Add a source to start the slideshow.

images.empty: No photos in the cache yet.
images.releaseSenderHint: Adds the address permanently. Future photos from this person go straight into the slideshow.
images.quarantineHint: These photos come from senders the frame does not know yet. A tap shows who sent them and asks whether to release just this photo or everything from that person.
images.allowedSenders: No sender approved yet | {n} sender approved | {n} senders approved

filter.undatedHint: Photos with no discernible capture date.

sources.title: Sources
sources.accessLost: Access expired — please pick the folder again
sources.removeConfirm: Remove source "{name}"? Cached photos will be deleted; nothing changes at the source.
sources.syncTruncated: Source is very large — only part of it was scanned.

sourceForm.kind_local_hint: A folder on the tablet or SD card
sourceForm.includeSeenHint: Needed when two frames share one mailbox. The frame then scans the whole folder and marks everything as read — better set up a dedicated folder than to use the inbox.
sourceForm.quarantineAllHint: Even known senders then wait for a tap on the frame.
sourceForm.allowedSendersHint: Anyone listed here skips the quarantine.
sourceForm.allowedSendersEmpty: Nobody approved yet. The list grows when you pick “trust sender” while releasing a photo.
sourceForm.removeSenderAsk:
Remove {sender}?

Future mail will wait for approval again.

Should the {n} existing photos go back to the quarantine as well?

OK = yes, back to quarantine
Cancel = no, keep them visible
sourceForm.removeSenderAskEmpty:
Remove {sender}?

Future mail will wait for approval again.
sourceForm.senderRemovedWith: Sender removed · {n} photos wait for approval again
sourceForm.maxMailsPerHourHint: Protection against a flood. 0 removes the limit.
sourceForm.name: Label
sourceForm.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored password
sourceForm.passwordHint: Recommended: create a separate read-only account.
sourceForm.usePreviewApiHint: Saves bandwidth and makes HEIC photos usable.
sourceForm.allowInsecureTlsHint: Only sensible on your own home network.
sourceForm.subfoldersHint: Separate several with commas. Empty = all.
sourceForm.minResolutionHint: Smaller photos are skipped. 0 = no filter.
sourceForm.testOkMailbox: Mailbox reachable · {n} unread message | Mailbox reachable · {n} unread messages
sourceForm.errorSafUnavailable: Local folders are only available in the Android app.
sourceForm.fetchLogHint: The last 50 runs. Failed ones are highlighted.
sourceForm.resyncHint: Scans the whole folder and fetches what is missing. Existing photos are left untouched.
sourceForm.resyncAsk: Fully resync the mailbox?\n\nThe frame scans every message in the folder — with a full mailbox this takes several minutes. The slideshow keeps running and you can cancel at any time.

show.title: Slideshow
show.newBoostHint: For the first 48 hours, at most three times per cycle.
show.leastRecentlyShown: Favour photos not shown for a while
show.clusterFilterHint: Two photos from the same minute never run back to back.
show.orientationHint: How the frame is mounted. "Automatic" follows the sensor.
show.fitCoverHint: Fill the screen, crop the edges
show.kenBurnsHint: Feels more alive, costs a little more processing.
show.pairModeHint: Two portrait photos side by side on the landscape display.
show.pairModeHintPortrait: Portrait reverses it: two landscape photos stacked.
show.quarantineHintHint: Shows on the frame when photos from unknown senders await approval.
show.pixelShiftHint: Slowly shifts the overlays — protects OLED displays.
show.showSettingsButtonHint: Shortcut to the settings, top right. When hidden, the long press remains.
show.showExcludeButtonHint: Takes the current photo out of the slideshow without deleting it at the source.
show.restartCycleHint: Reshuffles and starts over. Counters are kept.
show.resetHistoryHint: Sets counters and timestamps of the current set to zero.
show.resetHistoryAsk: Reset display history of {n} photos?\n\nCounters and timestamps are lost — the slideshow will treat every photo as new. The photos themselves stay.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.enabledHint: Outside the active hours the screen is dimmed.
schedule.overnightHint: If the end is before the start, the period runs past midnight.
schedule.nightClockHint: Instead of a completely black screen.
schedule.deviceBrightnessHint: The app hands over control and the system's automatic brightness applies. The screen still dims at night.

system.title: System
system.cacheHint: When the cache is full, the least recently shown photos are replaced.
system.prefetchHint: More means smoother transitions but uses more memory.
system.protectSettingsHint: Open only after a long press — prevents accidental changes.
system.remoteHint: Lets Home Assistant and similar systems control the slideshow.
system.remoteTokenHint: Leave empty for unrestricted access on your home network.
system.mqttHint: The frame connects to the broker. Unlike REST control, the tablet needs no fixed address.
system.mqttPasswordKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored password
system.mqttBaseTopicHint: One per device if you run several frames, e.g. "livingroom".
system.mqttDiscoveryHint: Creates switches, buttons and sensors by itself — no YAML needed.
system.databaseHint: Compares the index with the files on the device.
system.databaseFound: {missing} entries without file · {orphan} files without entry · {bytes} reclaimable
system.databaseRepairAsk: Clean up?\n\n{orphan} file(s) without an entry will be deleted, {missing} entr(ies) without a file removed from the index. Photos that belong to the slideshow are left untouched.
system.diagnosticsHint: For bug reports. Without mail addresses, server names and file names; senders appear as “Sender A”.
